summary: Computes a tile-grid layout for a viewport. Reads viewport bounds (0x120/0x124 and 0x140/0x144), walks the child linked list seeded at this[0xF0] to accumulate maximum tile width into this[0x160] and maximum tile height into this[0x164], then computes column/row counts (this[0x158], this[0x15C]) and a total/scroll value (this[0x16C]) based on layout mode this[0x100] (0 = vertical, 1 = horizontal). On overflow of the viewport bounds it resets the state flag this[0x104] and invokes a virtual reset method through vtable+0x40. Always calls UITileGrid (0x0048F870) and returns the result of a virtual call through vtable+0x2C with argument 1.

local_names.this[0xFC]: element count (i) used as iteration quantity
local_names.this[0x104]: state flag reset to 0 on overflow

operations.description: Initialize computed outputs to zero: this[0x160] = 0, this[0x164] = 0, this[0x158] = 0, this[0x15C] = 0, this[0x16C] = 0
Read viewport bounds: v2 = this[0x120], v3 = this[0x124] so v6 = v3 - v2; v5 = this[0x140], v4 = this[0x144] so v8 = v4 - v5
Seed the iteration cursor: this[0xF8] = linked-list head this[0xF0]; first node v9 = *head when head non-null, else v9 = 0

Walk the child linked list (element count i = this[0xFC]) while the current node is non-null: accumulate maximum node width (node+0xC) into this[0x160] and maximum node height (node+0x10) into this[0x164]; advance the cursor this[0xF8] via the node next pointer at node+4, stopping when it is null
Layout mode dispatch: read mode this[0x100]; value 0 takes the vertical branch, value 1 takes the horizontal branch, values above 1 fall through without computation
Horizontal mode (mode == 1): when max width this[0x160] is non-zero, rows this[0x15C] = v6 / (this[0x160] + spacing this[0x150])
Horizontal mode: columns this[0x158] and total this[0x16C] = i / rows this[0x15C] when rows is non-zero, each rounded up by +1 when i % rows > 0; when rows is zero, total this[0x16C] = i
Horizontal mode: v18 = spacing this[0x154] + max height this[0x164]; when v18 is non-zero, total this[0x16C] -= v8 / v18, clamp total to >= 0 when negative, then total *= v18
Vertical mode (mode == 0): when max height this[0x164] is non-zero, columns this[0x158] = v8 / (this[0x164] + spacing this[0x154])
Vertical mode: when prior rows this[0x15C] is non-zero, rows = i / prior rows; when columns this[0x158] is non-zero and i % columns > 0, increment rows this[0x15C]
Vertical mode: when max width this[0x160] is non-zero, total this[0x16C] = rows this[0x15C] - v6 / this[0x160]; clamp total to >= 0 when negative
Overflow test: if rows this[0x15C] * (max width this[0x160] + spacing this[0x150]) > v6 OR columns this[0x158] * (max height this[0x164] + spacing this[0x154]) > v8, take the reset path
On overflow, reset the state flag this[0x104] = 0
On overflow, invoke virtual thiscall through vtable this[0x0] at slot +0x40 with (this, 0) to reset state
Invoke UITileGrid (0x0048F870) with this to update tile positions
Return the result of the virtual thiscall through vtable this[0x0] at slot +0x2C with (this, 1)
